name: Strict Privacy Policy
description: Strict privacy policy with enhanced requirements. Use this when privacy is a high priority. All warnings are treated as errors.

rules.name: No Address Reuse
rules.description: Prevent reusing addresses within a transaction plan
rules.rationale: Address reuse is the most common privacy leak. Strict enforcement is required.

rules.name: Minimum Delay (Strict)
rules.rationale: Strict mode requires at least 30 minutes between steps to reduce timing correlation.

rules.name: No Same Block
rules.description: Prevent multiple transactions in the same block

rules.name: Minimum Hops (Strict)
rules.rationale: Strict mode requires more separation between source and destination.

rules.name: Amount Variation Required
rules.description: Prevent amounts that are too similar to the total
rules.rationale: Large single transfers are easily linked by amount matching.
